chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Yaḥyā ibn al-Mubārak, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: “A muhrim kissed a boy out of desire.” He said: “He is to be struck with one hundred lashes.”

key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a muhrim who kisses a boy with desire according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who kisses a boy with desire. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that such an act incurs a punishment of one hundred lashes, indicating the gravity of the offense in the legal tradition.
